name: perf_visual_ab
description: §28 visual-inertness proof. The two §28 memos are claimed to change NOTHING a player can see -- they cache a value inside the frame in which it is computed -- and this is the file that has to make that claim falsifiable rather than asserted. Same scenario is run on the pre-§28 build and the memoised one, and the frames are compared with Tools/FrameDelta; anything above median CIELAB deltaE 1 would mean a memo is serving a stale answer somewhere. Hours and weather are chosen to put every subsystem the memos feed into the frame at once: MapSky's gates and WeatherDimming's reads drive sky tint (§8), weather dimming (§13), the cloud lanes (§25) and the low-light desaturation wash (§9), and several of those are defined to zero at noon -- so noon alone would compare two frames in which most of the changed code never ran. 15.0 is full day with the sun high, 19.6 is the golden-hour angle §25's own playtest scenario uses, and 21.5 is past sunset where the night floor and desaturation take over. Overcast rather than Clear because DimmingFor returns exactly 0 under Clear, which would test the memo by not using it.
